page.overview:
What is Battle against the Children of E'ronoh?

In 382 BBY, a battle was fought on the Outer Rim planet Eiram when the Children of E'ronoh dissident group attempted to take the throne of the planet E'ronoh from its royal family. The attempt failed when the Children's leader, Rev Ferrol, crashed his drill ship into the sea.
